3263.title: Installed plugin details can select the wrong catalog entry
3263.rootCauseOneLine: The app drops the installed marketplace identity and selects catalog metadata by plugin ID alone.
3263.proposedFix: Preserve the installed marketplace name and require an exact marketplace-plus-entry match, falling back to installed metadata when no exact row exists.
3263.caveats: The reproduction uses contract-valid synthetic catalog responses and does not access the reporter's runtime or install third-party code.
